text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to make some snacks for<n>Super Creek to
have during her<n>training breaks, I decide to go out
and<n>shop for various ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious, look at all of the<n>stuff you
have... Are you planning a<n>party or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I would have cooked for you if you<n>had just told
me. Please remember<n>that you can ask me for
anything,<n>okay?
choice_data_list:
I thought you might want something to munch on
during your training breaks.

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry? You're saying that's for<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Nutrient intake during training is<n>necessary to
improve strength and<n>stamina. And I figured a tasty
treat<n>wouldn't hurt either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're planning to make the snacks<n>yourself
instead of just buying<n>nutrition bars?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm only who I am today because<n>you're always
working so hard for<n>my sake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You study so hard, are super<n>considerate, and give
me tons of<n>energy.
Which means I must find some way<n>to repay you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A gift of gratitude full of love to<n>soothe your body
and soul... Hehe! ♪
